tradeoffs.loses: seed=0 is no longer sent on Router-bound OpenAI requests, so repeated calls with the same prompt are not even nominally reproducible (OpenAI's seed was best-effort only; nothing in the pipeline reads system_fingerprint or depends on identical repeats)
tradeoffs.why: Without this the gpt/o1/o3 branches of get_response_from_llm and get_batch_responses_from_llm cannot be translated to Router's Responses API at all (the runtime keeps any request carrying seed on the provider), which is 5 of the 9 call sites and every idea/novelty/citation/review-reflection call when the pipeline runs on an OpenAI model.

tradeoffs.loses: The two pinned 2024 model snapshots are answered by newer models: claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620/-20241022 by claude-sonnet-4-6 and gpt-4o-2024-05-13 by gpt-4o (the 2024-08-06 build). Different weights give different ideas, reviews and scores; review scores are not comparable with runs on the old snapshots. o1-2024-12-17 maps to the same model under its undated catalog id.
tradeoffs.why: Router serves catalog ids only, and the catalog has no claude-3-5-sonnet-* and no gpt-4o-2024-05-13: as written, the default --model and the hard-pinned reviewer model would both stay on the provider, i.e. the pipeline's two main model choices would not be on Router at all. claude-sonnet-4-6 is the nearest same-family successor at the same list price ($3/$15) that still accepts temperature; gpt-4o is the later snapshot of the same model at half the input price.
